acceptanceCriteria: A retained receipt reports cold and warm index build time, snapshot bytes, and query/context/impact p50 and p95 on at least one 50k-file and one 200k-file public repository.
Every refusal or limit hit is recorded with its code and the ticket that owns it.
The README status table states the largest measured repository size.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner-requested gap analysis of Corvint against competing context tools, current standards and a trial on a local clone of MeVille (TypeScript, about 4,600 tracked files). The largest measured repository is Beamfall at 3,233 files (docs/specs/index-snapshot-v0.md). Known limits on the path to monorepo scale: the 128 MiB aggregate source bound refuses the whole Core loop (V1-0339), sparse-index repositories exhaust the Git process budget (V1-0287), and a reindex writes about 63 MB per tree (V1-0328). Monorepo support is table stakes for every commercial context engine. On the 4,600-file MeVille clone, impact took 2.1 s and query 1.1 s.
